name: Poirot Investigates: The Million Dollar Bond Robbery
source:
Play as Hastings, friend of the famous detective Poirot, and solve The Million Dollar Bond Robbery, in this tiny visual novel based on a short story by Agatha Christie. 

[from [url=https://spiralatlas.itch.io/poirot-investigates-bond]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这部改编自阿加莎·克里斯蒂短篇小说的小型视觉小说中，扮演著名侦探波洛的朋友黑斯廷斯，侦破百万美元债券抢劫案。

[来自[url=https://spiralatlas.itch.io/poirot-investigates-bond]itch.io[/url]]
